scripts.//test: Serial by necessity: @buildflow/database and @buildflow/api integration tests share ONE database and both truncate `companies` in beforeEach. Each package already sets vitest fileParallelism:false, but that only orders files WITHIN a package — pnpm -r runs packages concurrently, so the two suites raced and produced intermittent failures that looked like tenant-isolation bugs. Give each package its own schema before restoring concurrency.
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm arch && pnpm icons:build
scripts.infra:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml down -v && pnpm infra:up
